method: OCP IntCurvesFace_ShapeIntersector on exact trimmed BREP faces; outward normals from BRepGProp_Face at exact UV; transition and interval states verified with BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier
limitations: These are straight input-ray intersections, not precomputed refracted paths. They validate primitive/BVH boundary solvers used by sequential Snell transport.
ELEMENTS and LIGHT are separate native module coordinate frames; their local coordinates must not be combined as colocated scene solids.
Air intervals include internal bubble, cable exclusion, glass cavity, and port voids. Opaque cable and surrounding hardware are not classified here.
Normals at native seam/edge coincidences may have multiple candidate faces; the face with largest absolute ray-normal dot is retained and all face IDs are recorded.
This extraction does not modify native CAD, mesh caches, package, runtime, or source.
